description: §7.3.5 (S480) — five unread arm binders, each W-UNUSED-BINDING (a Warning): `r` and `h` of a value `match`'s arms, `why` of a `!{}` arm, the whole-error binder `err` of `_ err`, and `r` of a `<match>` arm. The program compiles; the warnings do not change it.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S480-unused-binding-six (item 2: "Unread `match` / `!{}` / `<match>` arm binders ARE reported" — RULED yes)
rationale: §7.3.5: "Each binder of a `match` arm or a `!{}` arm (`.V(x)`, `.Ok(v)`, a whole-error `_ err`) and of a `<match>` arm (§18.7) that nothing in the arm reads SHALL be reported as W-UNUSED-BINDING." One report per binder; `.Rect(_, _)` binds nothing.

codes: severity:code 'W-UNUSED-BINDING' did not fire (expected severity warning)
